column1: # Privacy Protection (agent/apps/app/modules/privacy, the side panel's status line, Settings, Privacy).
# Terms follow Redrob Cowork's 개인정보 보호 copy, so one product's words match the other's: 개인정보 보호

# "provider" and "model" are not used in copy (Cowork's rule); the on-device model is "a small model on

column2: Details with a fixed shape are caught reliably. Names, organisations and addresses depend on the on-device model and the names you list, so a rare spelling can get through. At Standard, text inside screenshots is sent as it is.
